$schema_note: Live measurements for the Mark 1 set (ForgePact#166 phase 1, research only, Live 1, Live 2 and Live 3, all 2026-10-13): how a bar slot can be cast through the game's own gate without a key press, which input entry each of Q, E, R and Y uses, what a toggle does under that lever, what a cast does to the walk, which script moves the player on a walk and during a jump, where a x0.5 on walking speed and a x3 on the jump land, and which reading tells a walkable landing point from one past the walkable map's edge. Research build of ForgePact 2feb9b4 (DLL SHA-256 0557663379cfbb08d1a976896f1b79712eae72dff47138e8f38194c08b02b97f; the plugin/ tree is unchanged at the head of the 166-mark1-set branch), the `mark1probe` instrument (nine script rows through HookOneScript, its levers and its pos sampler) and x64dbg hardware logpoints (CheckTalentUse as the control; TalentUseSetSpeed, StatMovementSpeed and StatJumpPower as candidates); save slot 14, character Sorak (White Mage), in Town_01_rm, every shipped mod off. Live 3 (walkability only) ran on a rebuilt research DLL, ForgePact 61243b2 (SHA-256 8c47459b15dd0691336efd65e5c9ded6ebd1a46b23e578e9688f71d023ad516e), with the same character, room and starting save and no debugger. The procedures, their checks and the argument are in ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live procedure 1, Live procedure 2, Results with Live 3 results, Decision, Not established); the shared facts are docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md sections 7.7, 7.8, 19.10 and 19.11; the session captures forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-1.md, -live-2.md and -live-3.md stay with the hub's workorder files and are not tracked. No model or generator reads this file: tests/test_sdk_all.py checks only that curated/ is tracked, and the #166 workorder's criterion 24 reads game_build, cast_route, slot_keys, cast_penalty, walk_mover, speed_lever, jump_mover, jump_lever and walkable. A status is one of: measured, not-observed (the check ran, its control passed, and it saw nothing), not-run (the check did not run, or its control failed, so it says nothing) or static reading (read locally from the game, never measured). The decision value is the research doc's Decision key as recorded; each entry's checks carry their tools/live_checks.py verdicts. Addresses and call-site offsets are never recorded here; the callers are named. Static readings are our own words, never the game's text.

args: the local player, as a VALUE_REF
gate_args.what: Every local CheckTalentUse call read, 100 idle and 100 twice with Q held down, carried the same three arguments, one call per frame, and every call the probe counted was the local player's. No argument names a bar slot. Holding Q down cast nothing in either window, so the value for a pressed slot was not seen (hence not-observed); the cast is driven by the input entry instead (slot_keys, cast_route).
gate_args.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 1 results); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-1.md (S6), not tracked

slot_keys.profile_slot: Input_Device_Manager_obj instance 0, playerProfileSlot entry 1 (the index CheckTalentUse's third argument names)
slot_keys.what: Each bar key moved one inputState entry of the profile slot, the bar column its slot sits on (Q on column 3 to Y on column 6). Entries 26 and 25 moved together with Q and E, for a reason not read. The other bar columns were not measured.
slot_keys.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 1 results); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-1.md (S7), not tracked

cast_route.what: With no key pressed, writing the press value 4 into the slot's inputState entry just before each local CheckTalentUse call, and restoring it after, cast the slot's skill. During two key presses with one cast, none of the first four entries (0-3) of abilityQueue, mobileTalentPressed or the player's stackSkillList changed between end-of-frame samples; later slots and an entry set and cleared within one gate call were not visible, so whether a key cast uses the queue is not established. The queue and mobile levers were not tried, because the input lever cast first.
cast_route.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 1 results, Decision); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-1.md (S5, S8, S9), not tracked

cast_gate.what: With the press value forced on every gate call for more than 480 frames (about 5.6 s at ~85 fps), Mana Orb was cast once; what refused the repeats (cooldown, mana, the orb still alive, or how the forced press is seen) and Mana Orb's cooldown were not read, so whether the cooldown applies to a forced press is not established. The lever on an empty column called no TalentUse at all. The mana half was not seen: in a 120-frame watch of the player no member named for mana fell (manaArrayPos moved upwards). Its control, key-cast-control, passed in the same session.
cast_gate.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 1 results, Decision); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-1.md (S10, S13), not tracked

toggle_under_automation.what: The input lever held on the toggle's column switched it on and off again every 10 to 30 frames; it does not stay on.
toggle_under_automation.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 1 results); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-1.md (S12), not tracked

cast_penalty.pst: an array of 54 entries, neither a struct nor an instance; the probe's pst watch reads no members of it
cast_penalty.what: The penalty itself is measured: Healing Zone cast one second into a three-second walk cut the step to about 0.65 of itself for about 21 frames, then it climbed back; the walk covered 6.5% less than the controls' mean. Every TalentUseSetSpeed logpoint hit returned to its one direct call site in TalentUse (CA_playerTalentActive not observed). No player member that changes at the cast and settles back was found, and pSt could not be watched, so the member holding the penalty is not observed and no lever was tried.
cast_penalty.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 1 results, Decision); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-1.md (S14 to S17), not tracked

walk_mover.what: During a walk PlayerMovement runs once a frame, but none of the nine rows' calls changes the player's position: the walk's displacement is applied outside all of them. StatMovementSpeed runs once a frame standing or walking, every call returning to the dispatcher's direct call site in ReturnSpecificStat, and nothing called it directly.
walk_mover.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 2 results, Decision); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-2.md (T4, T5), not tracked

speed_lever.what: x0.5 on id 64's result at the dispatcher, on every call for 240 frames, slowed the walk's step to 0.785 of itself, not 0.5. The lever scaled only the dispatcher's answer: skip=240 means every local StatMovementSpeed call inside the dispatcher returned a non-number to the probe, so the getter route never scaled (changed_getter 0), against the probe core's tested model. Halving the dispatcher's id-64 answer gave 0.785 of the step. Whether the step is not proportional to it (base, cap, floor), whether the walk also reads movement speed by a route the dispatcher lever does not reach (e.g. the cached pSt values PlayerMovement reads), and why the getter's own result was not a number to the probe (skip=240) are not established. The move lever did not run (instrument: no row moves the walk).
speed_lever.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 2 results, Decision); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-2.md (T6, T7), not tracked

jump_mover.what: The jump is moved by skillsLeap alone; playerJumpGravity runs alongside and never moves the player. StatJumpPower logged no hit over six jumps while the control logpoint kept logging. The jump's state members were not read (pSt unreadable by the probe's watch).
jump_mover.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 2 results, Decision); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-2.md (T8, T9), not tracked

jump_lever.what: x3 on each skillsLeap call's own displacement tripled the jump, near and far, well past the jump's usual reach of about 246 px. x3 on Jump Power never engaged: a jump neither entered StatJumpPower nor asked the dispatcher for id 66; whether it reads a cached Jump Power value (e.g. in pSt, refreshed by the player's Alarm 8) is not established. Whether the game's own landing checks still hold at a scaled landing point was not measured.
jump_lever.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 2 results, Decision); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-2.md (T10, T11), not tracked

walkable.test: room=in and family=free: the point lies inside the room, and the player placed there meets nothing of Collision_Parent_obj (place_meeting)

raw_kinds.place_meeting: real 0 (no meeting) or 1 (a meeting), not bool, when called through CallBuiltinEx with the player as self and other
raw_kinds.mp_grid_get_cell: real: 0 free, -1 blocked or outside the grid

control_reading.points: the player's own position and 32 px to either side, open floor

prop.note: only family saw the prop; points on its drawn sprite above its base read free on every field

edge.marked_by: Invisible_Wall_Not_Minimap_obj instances, met by place_meeting as Collision_Parent_obj and returned by collision_line as Wall_Parent_obj; nothing on screen draws them
edge.order: family blocked first, then grid (-1) and wall-line (crossed) one 16 px step later; all stayed blocked to the room's bottom
edge.past_room: room=out, grid blocked and wall-line crossed, but family free again past the invisible walls
edge.other_blockers: water (Block_Dynamic_Sprite_obj), Fall_Rock_01_obj and Fall_Dead_Tree_02_obj block both grid and family, wall-line clear

walkable.tile: none of the four tile layers read (Darkness, Hay_Ground, Leaves_Ground, Water) marks the edge; Town_01_rm's later tile layers were not read; values vary across open floor, Water is non-zero only on water, every layer reads -1 outside the room
walkable.live_2: walkable-control failed: that build's probe counted any number of 0 or more from place_meeting as a meeting, so its real 0 printed blocked everywhere; corrected in ForgePact 61243b2
walkable.what: In Town_01_rm a walkable landing point is one inside the room where the player would meet nothing of Collision_Parent_obj. family alone saw the prop, which the path grid and the wall line missed, and turned blocked at the edge 16 px before them, but read free past the room's bottom, where only room and the grid still said no. Not measured: a generated zone, why the path grid's cells under the Bounty Board read free, whether pockets between blockers are reachable on foot, and the test at a jump's landing.
walkable.source: ForgePact docs/mark1-set-research.md (Live 3 results, Decision, Not established); forgepact-166-mark1-set-live-3.md (W2 to W4), not tracked
